title: A new Ising/tricritical-Ising interface: From W3 symmetry to Rydberg atoms
abstract: We consider interfaces between critical spin-chains in different universality classes, described in the continuum limit by defect/interface conformal field theory (DCFT/ICFT). We find a new conformal interface between the Tricritical Ising (TIM) and the Ising CFT, characterized by an emergent W3 symmetry, and propose its realization in Rydberg atom arrays.
key_claims: New conformal interface between Tricritical Ising and Ising CFT with emergent W3 chiral symmetry
Extends the Rydberg-CFT correspondence landscape; relevant if HYP-025 (universality of alpha: Ising vs Z3 chiral clock) is pursued; peripheral to alpha~4 force measurement itself
